hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site details for every site (Electricity Hookup '50', Water Hookup 'Y' on all electric sites; e.g. https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=3250&parkId=552903) + the park notes on every site page ('There are no sewer hookups on any campsites. There is a dump station conveniently located near the entrance to the campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The booking site lists 103 sites: Area A 31 without hookups, Areas B (46) and C (26) with 50-amp electric and water. The park page says 182 sites, 134 of them electric. Two pull-throughs in Area A; listed driveways run 55-146 ft.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Crosswinds offers 182 campsites for recreational vehicles, tent and trailer camping; 134 sites have electric and water hookups') + ReserveAmerica site list and every Crosswinds site page, read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Showers, restrooms, trash containers, and a dump station are conveniently located'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water to individual sites is shut off in winter; the shower houses keep water.

season.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area (Operating Season Schedule 2026 and 2027, Crosswinds Campground: 'Camping areas A to C Jan. 1, 2027 Dec. 31, 2027') + ReserveAmerica park notes ('During the winter season, water is shut off for individual campsites. There is still water available at the shower houses'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites can be booked for today and up to 6 months ahead. Holiday weekends need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552903 (Booking Window, Campsite Electric / Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'; Business Rules for Holiday Weekends: '2 nights Minimum Stay on holiday weekend', '1 night Minimum Stay on holiday weekend if the booking dates within 14 Days before Arrival Date'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites without hookups $30 a night and electric/water sites $40, each including the $3-a-night service fee that the booking site adds to its $27 / $37 camping fee (charged on in-person bookings too). Seniors 62+, veterans and military members get $6 off a night with ID at check-in. No out-of-state rate; federal passes are not accepted. Cancelling costs $15 per reservation.

fees.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/about-us/state-parks-reservation-rates-and-activity-fees ('RV with electric and water hookups $40'; 'Tent, trailer, or RV site with no hookups $30'; 'All prices listed on this website page include the $3 service fee'; 'A $3 service fee is charged for all reservations, including those made in-person'; 'Seniors, veterans, and military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on certain campsite reservations'; 'we do not accept federal passes, such as the America the Beautiful Pass') + ReserveAmerica price breakdowns https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=3211&parkId=552903 (Area A site A003, 2026-11-10: 'Camping Fees (1 night) $27.00 Per Night') and https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=3250&parkId=552903 (Area B site B003, 2026-11-10: '$37.00 Per Night') ('Reservation Fees $3.00 Per Night'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/about-us/state-parks-reservation-rates-and-activity-fees ('Seniors, veterans, and military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on certain campsite reservations'; 'we do not accept federal passes, such as the America the Beautiful Pass, or passes for other states'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Added 50-amp electric and water with no sewer, 103 bookable sites (72 electric), showers and dump station, year-round season (site water off in winter), ReserveAmerica booking (6-month window, holiday minimum waived within 14 days), $30 / $40 rates and the senior/military discount.
flags: Site count: ReserveAmerica lists 103 Crosswinds sites (72 electric); ncparks.gov says 182 (134 electric). The gap is too big to be host sites; either the park page is out of date or many sites are not on the booking site.
